style: dad who writes everything as dash bullet lists, clipped, times and floor numbers included

situations.name: Taking the elevator to the orthodontist on the sixth floor
situations.feared_outcome: The elevator will get stuck between floors and I won't be able to breathe

behaviors.text: Steps into the elevator, then jumps back out before the doors close and takes the stairs
Heads straight for the stairs without trying the elevator
Stands right by the panel and keeps pressing the door-open button

accommodations.text: Dad walks the six flights of stairs with her
Dad calls the front desk to say they will be late

situations.name: Riding the elevator at her aunt's apartment building

behaviors.text: Only rides if dad is in the elevator with her
Counts the floors under her breath (could be calming herself, could be habit)

accommodations.text: Dad always rides up and down with her

situations.name: Going through the automatic car wash
situations.feared_outcome: The doors will lock and we'll be stuck inside

behaviors.text: Gets out of the car and waits in the lot while dad drives through

monitoring_log.situation: - Car wash on the way home
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed:

- Waited by the vacuums

monitoring_log.parent_response:

monitoring_log.parent_response:
- Rode with her
- Told her she did great

voice_notes.text: ok quick one the four fifteen ortho appointment she rode up to the sixth floor with me which is huge um but she held the door open button like the whole way so it kept stopping and I'd say she was a seven
voice_notes.trap: 'four fifteen' is a time and 'sixth floor' a floor number; the fear level is 7

voice_notes.text: at dee's tonight she waited for me before she'd get in the elevator and uh counted the floors again two three four under her breath
voice_notes.trap: 'two three four' is her counting floors, not a fear level
